Functional Medicine in Garner, NC

I'm Adam Seay, D.C. Root Health is the functional medicine side of my practice in Garner, run alongside Seay Wellness, my chiropractic practice, at the same address. Most of the people I see have already been told their labs are normal, and they still feel unwell.

Book a free Discovery Session Call 919-662-0520

Who comes to see me

  • Tired all the time, with labs that keep coming back normal
  • On thyroid medication and still feeling hypothyroid
  • Gut problems that have outlasted several specialists
  • Brain fog, poor sleep, or weight that will not move
  • Symptoms that started after an illness and never fully cleared
  • On a GLP-1 medication and wanting to protect muscle and long-term health

How the work goes

It starts with your history and a careful look at what has and has not been tested. Testing is chosen by your pattern, not ordered all at once. Whatever we find gets addressed in a sensible order, measured against how you actually feel, and coordinated with your other doctors. I do not ask anyone to stop a prescription. This work runs alongside your medical care, not in place of it.
